REL-01.delivered: Startup restore, login controls, USB recovery and saved running intent merged in #41. Profiles are implemented in 0.5.
REL-01.remaining: Physical startup, replug, busy-device and capture permission validation.

REL-02.delivered: Independent sleep, display and lock handling with intended-state restoration merged in #41.
REL-02.remaining: Physical overlapping lock/display/suspend validation. Wayland display sleep unsupported; Mac lock events best effort.

AUD-01.delivered: Spectrum, bass, level and wave styles plus adaptive spectral-flux beat pulse, input gain, sensitivity, noise gate, release and live input telemetry.
AUD-01.remaining: Real-device audio response, routing and permissions on all platforms.

REL-03.delivered: Missed engine deadlines, allowlisted diagnostic report with preview/copy/export, optional local history (200 changes / 7 days), clear/disable controls and recovery guidance.
REL-03.remaining: Physical recovery and export checks on macOS/Linux; video-source drops are not measured.

UI-04.delivered: Native per-mode settings memory persists with settings. Effect direction is independent of physical strip direction. Existing focused panels, source controls, calibration and profiles remain available.
UI-04.remaining: Physical mode switching and directional animation checks.

UI-08.delivered: Main-window and tray status share the native engine; lifecycle recovery, Retry and Stop are implemented.

UI-10.delivered: Semantic controls, visible focus, responsive layouts and reduced-motion effect previews shipped in #40.
UI-10.remaining: Complete keyboard, contrast, scaling and Windows/macOS screen-reader validation.

PLAT-01.delivered: Intel and Apple Silicon DMG builds pass CI. README documents unsigned installation and platform limitations.
PLAT-01.remaining: Physical Mac USB, capture, permission, tray and lifecycle validation.

AUT-01.delivered: Named profiles with create, rename, duplicate, delete, reorder, favorites, settings updates and configurable global shortcuts. Atomic persistence and conflict rejection; hardware and privacy settings preserved.
AUT-01.remaining: Physical shortcut and capture-consent checks on macOS/Linux and Windows.

UI-06.delivered: Native tray/menu bar with Start/Stop, brightness presets, recent colors, favorites, status and Retry, synchronized with the main window.
UI-06.remaining: Physical appearance and keyboard checks across desktops. Floating-controller synchronization awaits #32.

HW-01.delivered: Temporary low-brightness LED-by-LED calibration with count, direction, offset, coverage, mapped-edge preview, apply/cancel, prior-state restoration and immediate Stop.
HW-01.remaining: Physical strip verification of first LED, direction, coverage and restoration.

SCR-01.delivered: Optional stable symmetric black-bar exclusion, RGB balance, saturation, gamma, reset, time-based smoothing and brightness transition limits.
SCR-01.remaining: Representative SDR/HDR video and physical capture testing on each platform. HDR tone mapping is not implemented.

FX-05.delivered: Screen colors modulated by audio, blend strength, sensitivity/smoothing, silence behavior, per-source fallback and one USB writer. Shared brightness limits apply.
FX-05.remaining: Physical simultaneous capture, source-loss, Retry and comfort checks.

FX-03.delivered: Global maximum brightness, time-based change limiting to soften flashes, optional minimum glow and immediate Stop across every mode.
FX-03.remaining: Physical comfort-control validation. These controls are not a medical safety guarantee.
